_meta.title: UNET
_meta.note: Loads krea2 (Krea-2-Turbo), the design-mandated primary model (design 5.3b), from a Q4_K_M GGUF quant. image_router.pick_template() only routes here once this file exists on disk at its full size -- see pipeline/image_router.py. The ComfyClient ban-check reads unet_name here.

_meta.title: CLIP
_meta.note: krea2 text encoder: Qwen3-VL-4B 'fp8_scaled' from the official Comfy-Org/Krea-2 repackaged repo (found 2026-07-11 via the community workflow's source URLs).

_meta.title: VAE
_meta.note: Qwen-Image VAE (AutoencoderKLQwenImage, 16-channel latent) -- NOT flux's ae.safetensors. Feeds node 15's decode.

_meta.title: PROMPT_POS
_meta.note: The assembled sd_prompt lands here (patched per shot by ComfyClient). Also feeds node 12's zero-out negative.

_meta.title: NEG_ZEROOUT
_meta.note: krea2-Turbo is CFG-distilled (KSampler cfg=1.0), so a text negative has no effect -- per the model card and the validated panel_txt2img_krea.json graph, the negative conditioning is a zero-out of the positive instead of a second CLIPTextEncode. There is no PROMPT_NEG patch title on this template.

_meta.title: LATENT
_meta.note: 16-channel latent canvas sized for the Qwen-Image VAE (NOT EmptyLatentImage). Patched to 1216x704 for panels/plates, 832x1216 portrait for character refs.

_meta.title: SAMPLER
_meta.note: krea2-Turbo's validated recipe (panel_txt2img_krea.json proof render, 2026-07-10): euler/simple, 12 steps, cfg 1.5, denoise 1.0 -- krea2 is not flux, do not change without a fresh model_lab proof render. SEED is patched per shot from hash(scene_id, shot_id, retry) so every panel is reproducible from its sidecar json.

_meta.title: DECODE
_meta.note: Latent -> RGB pixels via the Qwen-Image VAE from node 3.

_meta.title: SAVE
_meta.note: Writes the PNG under ComfyUI/output/<SAVE_PREFIX>; ComfyClient then copies it into the project's panels/refs directory and renames it deterministically.
